name: 86 Chaos 16.0.16 Schedule Hours Union Math Fix
label: 16.0.16 Schedule Hours Union Math Fix
notes: Recalculates Scheduled Hours Tracker from merged per-day time intervals instead of raw shift-document totals.
Rejects impossible same-meridiem ranges such as 10p-3p instead of treating them as 17-hour overnight shifts.
Normalizes duplicate shift times like 10a-9p and 10:00-21:00 so hidden duplicate docs cannot inflate weekly hours.
